content:
Here i will put a "step by step" "guide" for owl update as of v2.1 yada yada
This guide is split into 7 “tiers” of progression.
this is kinda unfinished and based solely on my opinion so feel free to leave comments and suggestions.
Note that this guide promotes the use of the owl sheet made by stark
# THE SHEET WAS MADE BY STARK NOT ME I CANT UPDATE IT
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19Ty2kKvqBvbA7_mTsIqYLtEvKZyY99-t_TVgSSyOCi4/edit?usp=sharing

__**Tier 0**: Starting__
Go to the red mushrooms map and click the rope above the tree,
This will send you to the Grand Owl Perch so you can begin your journey for +0.01 dr!

__Note:__ You can hold to upgrade, do it so your fingers won't melt.
__Another Note:__ Avoid upgrading the second upgrade at the start, it's a waste of feathers

__**Tier 1**: unlocking the first megafeather.__
This first tier is the hardest and could take you around 1-3 hours actively.
Your goal is to restart asap.
Using the sheet at the top of the page, upgrade accordingly to the best upgrade.

Start out by getting the cheapener to the point it's not worth buying anymore, aka red in the sheet.
This will save you a lot of feathers.

At 250m feathers, you'll unlock Shiny Feathers, if you are confused on how this upgrade works, you passively get Shiny Feathers, each upgrade will make each Shiny Feather give +1%.
# The upgrade level doesn't mean how rare the shiny feathers are
This upgrade is monumental and will make your fps(feathers per second) go very high very quickly.

After putting a few levels into it and getting to 5000M feathers, you'd unlock “Super Feather Cheapener” which is a more powerful cheapener.
A few levels into it will decrease your upgrades cost by a lot.

The next step is getting to 100B feathers to unlock the 9th upgrade, the ability to Mega Reset, it should cost 2-3B when you unlock it, so getting to 100B feathers will likely allow you to instantly buy it.
This is recommended to do around the 6th restart.
This will reset all your upgrades except the second one, “Bonuses Of Orion”. and grant you the first mega feather, the “Maple Megafeather” giving you 10x feather.
# ** **

__**Tier 2**:unlocking the 3rd megafeather__
Now that you have the first megafeather, 10x feather gains, progressing the tiers becomes much much easier and faster!


Your next goal is to unlock the 3rd mega feather, because the second mega feather doesn't affect your feather gains.
Hence the journey from megafeather 1 to megafeather 2 will be around the same as megafeather 2 to megafeather 3.

The time from each megafeather takes around an hour and a half actively at this stage.

your steps should be the same as getting the first mega feather, they will just be faster!
This tier should take around 3 hours.
The third megafeather will give you 1% less cost per level of first upgrade.
# ** **

__**Tier 3**:unlocking the 5th megafeather__
Pretty much the same as the previous tiers
Will take a couple of hours.
This time, put some focus on the first upgrade as it now also reduces your cost!
The 5th megafeather will make the cheapeners also contribute feathers per second.
this tier should also take around 3 hours
# ** **

__**Tier 4**:unlocking the 7th megafeather__
This is a monumental tier, as the 7th megafeather is the strongest and most important one, it makes the 3x feather bonus you get from restarting, 5x.
With the 5th megafeather, making cheapeners also contribute fps, you'd want to focus on the first upgrade and the cheapeners to both get fps and less cost at the same time.
Unlock the 7th megafeather asap
It will make the restarts give more bonus towards feather gain
this tier should take around 2 hours
# ** **

__**Tier 5**:unlocking the 9th megafeather__
This is the easiest tier, as the 7th megafeather is just way too broken.
The steps are the same as tier 4, but a lot faster.
this tier should take around 1 hour or even less
# ** **

__**Tier 6**:the endgame__
Now that you have the first 9 megafeathers, you got all the megafeathers that contribute towards feather gain.

So grinding mega feathers will become harder and harder from here on out.
Get resets and buy orion/megafeather whenever you can
# ** **

__My Route(personal tip):__
Start by getting to restart 6, this should give you the necessary fps to unlock the 5000m at the very start.
start by buying out the 8th and 4th upgrades, followed by 7th, then return to 8th and 4th and then to 7th again, after that go to upgrade 1 and upgrade until you can't, then return to 8th and 4th and then to 7th again.
after that go to 3rd and upgrade until you can't, and then to 6th and max it.
# Buy restart whenever you can
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1249511644149579797/1252654844552941661/OwlUpgrades.png?ex=6673013c&is=6671afbc&hm=6a49c9ba1328905f076127fd476eef9c2e08f14db4b7ca7198e52d10e97c6250&

# 🦉MEGA FEATHERS🪶 
 
** **
> **1** - Multiplies feather gain by 10x
> 
> **2** - All bonuses from Upgrade 2 are now doubled.
> 
> **3** - Upgrade 1 now also gives 1% less cost for upgrades.
> 
> **4** - All bonuses from Upgrade 2 are now tripled(x3) instead of Doubled
> 
>  **5** - Upgrade 4 now also gives 2 feathers per second and Upgrade 8 now also 
> gives 4 feathers per second.
> 
> **6** - All bonuses from Upgrade 2 are now x4 instead of x3
> 
> **7** - Upgrade 5(the feather restart) now gives x5 feather gen instead of x3
> so (x5, 25, 125, ...)instead of (x3, 9 ,27,....)
> 
> **8 **- All bonuses from Upgrade 2 are now x5 instead of x4
> 
> **9** - Upgrade 1's cost now scales 25% slower
> 
> **10** - All bonuses from Upgrade 2 are now x6 instead of x5.
> 
> +0.5x for every time you bought Upgrade 9 after unlocking this one.
> so
> **11** - x6.5
> **12** - x7
> **13** - x7.5
> etc...
> Yes, there are more mega feathers after the tenth, an infinite more.
